description.value: ELEM is a Michelin Guide-listed modern restaurant on Main Street in Vancouver, where Chef Vish Mayekar weaves together global cuisines — South Asian, Japanese, Latin American — with bold technique and locally sourced ingredients. Named Best New Restaurant 2026 by Vancouver Magazine and ranked on Canada's 100 Best, it has quickly become one of the city's most talked-about dining destinations. Private dining is available, and the cocktail program features a dedicated zero-proof section alongside inventive spirit-forward drinks.
